# Jungle Oats

> A platform game Lance Guyatt made in 2005 with Freehand MX and Flash MX, playable in the browser via the Ruffle Flash emulator.

- Genre: platform game, single player
- Controls: arrow keys to move, spacebar to jump (click the game first to give it keyboard focus)
- Needs a keyboard, so it is best played on desktop

## Links

- [Play Jungle Oats](https://jungleoats.netlify.app/): the game and a short description
- [Lance Guyatt](https://lanceguyatt.com/): the author's website
